fields.label: Region / Location
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — city/state/country; note if the business is local-only, national, or global

fields.label: Practitioner / Team Credentials
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — qualifications, years in the field, certifications, notable results, team size and roles, tools/software owned, any licensing already held

fields.label: Delivery Capacity
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — solo operator, small team (size), agency, or platform/software; roughly how many clients or units can be served at once at each level of hands-on involvement

fields.label: Target Service / Offer to Ladder
fields.fallback_instruction: Leave blank for Wish 1-5 and Wish 7 — the Genie draws from the full service catalogue. REQUIRED only when Wish / Mode = Wish 6.
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — the specific service, product, or category this ladder is being built around. Leave blank only for Wish 1–5 and Wish 7, where the Genie should draw from the full service catalogue; REQUIRED for Wish 6

fields.label: ICP Document
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — paste, attach, or reference "use the ICP established earlier in this conversation." Should cover: avatar name/archetype, demographics, psychographics, core pains and fears, goals, decision criteria, awareness level, objections, and the language they actually use

fields.label: CRO / Messaging Framework
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — paste, attach, or reference "use the CRO audit / pillar page copy established earlier in this conversation." Used to keep offer titles and rationale consistent with existing brand voice and psychological triggers already in play

fields.label: Competitor Analysis
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — paste, attach, reference a file, or say "use the competitor analysis established earlier in this conversation." Should cover what competitors currently sell at each price point, what's overpriced/underpriced relative to the market, and any gap in the competitive offer stack

fields.label: Existing Offers Already in Market
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — list anything this business already sells today, at any price point, so the Genie extends the ladder rather than duplicating or cannibalising it

sub_fields.label: Annual value of the outcome to the customer
sub_fields.fallback_instruction: If unknown, leave blank and the Genie will state its assumption before proceeding.
sub_fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — revenue gained, cost avoided, hours saved × their hourly rate, or risk removed. If unknown, leave blank and the Genie will state its assumption before proceeding

sub_fields.label: Customer's typical budget or spend norms for this category
Currency
sub_fields.fallback_instruction: Defaults to USD if left blank.
sub_fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — e.g. AUD, USD, GBP. Defaults to USD if left blank

fields.label: Regulated Field Flag
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — Yes/No. If yes, name the regulation (medical, legal, financial, insurance, immigration, childcare, real estate, etc.) so compliance notes are attached correctly

fields.label: Regulation Name
fields.raw_explanation: Name the regulation (medical, legal, financial, insurance, immigration, childcare, real estate, etc.) so compliance notes are attached correctly.

fields.label: Wish / Mode
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — select one: Wish 1 (Free/Lead Gen) · Wish 2 (Low-Ticket) · Wish 3 (Mid-Range) · Wish 4 (High-Ticket) · Wish 5 (Premium) · Wish 6 (Single Offer Type Laddered) · Wish 7 (Full Ladder Blueprint)

fields.label: Number of Items (optional override)
fields.fallback_instruction: Leave blank to use the default count for the selected Wish.
